data.description: Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/response#k5): Replace the process-first one-to-one as the plan's entrance. New entrance: (i) talk first with the non-avoidant third flatmate — the available, easy conversation — to co-own the proposal and to hear whether they perceive a fairness problem; (ii) start the artifact asynchronously and opt-in: one person opens the shared list with this week's tasks, done-lines, claiming rule, no-blame and rewrite rules, and a review date, joinable without any meeting; (iii) include an explicit stand-down line ('I don't want to run this — rearrange it freely'), co-signed if the third flatmate agrees, de-centering the user as convener; (iv) reserve the one-to-one with the avoidant friend until after the opt-in window, where it can be informed by whatever the window showed.
